messages.subject: eval SparkR syntax
parts:
Hi,

I have a java maven app that produces SparkR code.
I am using your ScriptEngine.eval() function to perform syntax validation in a unit test class.
Everything works just fine, but with code like this:

xxx_df_complaints <- sql("select * from complaints")

example1 <- selectExpr(xxx_df_complaints, "product", "company")

example2 <- selectExpr(xxx_df_complaints, "zip_code", "product", "company")


 I get an evalException:

org.renjin.eval.EvalException: could not find function 'sql'


Is this not valid R syntax?

Would you know how else to validate syntax ?


thank you in advance




--
Mihai Popa <mi...@lattica.com>
Lattica, Inc.

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: eval SparkR syntax
parts:
Hi Mihai,

ScriptEngine.eval() will actually *evaluate* your R code. So functions like "sql" or "selectExpr" would need to be defined, either by yourself or more likely by loading a package. 

If you are just interested in validating the *syntax*, you can use Renjin's parser:
http://javadoc.renjin.org/latest/org/renjin/parser/RParser.html#parseAllSource(java.io.Reader,%20org.renjin.sexp.SEXP)

Best,
Alex
